articles.body:
Spring Boot makes it easy to create stand-alone, production-grade Spring based Applications that you can "just run". In this article, we will explore the fundamentals of Spring Boot and build a simple REST API.

## Prerequisites
- Java 11 or higher
- Basic understanding of Spring Framework
- Maven or Gradle

## Creating Your First Application
Start by visiting start.spring.io and selecting your dependencies...
articles.description: A comprehensive guide to building your first Spring Boot application
articles.title: Getting Started with Spring Boot
